name: perpetual-for-vscode
description: Run Codex and Claude Code sessions from VS Code with model switching, handoffs, GitHub repos, and Docker Sandbox support.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Perpetual can show its view in Restricted Mode, but repository access, local CLI execution, and Docker Sandbox runs require a trusted workspace.

perpetual.defaultAgent.description: Default agent for new Perpetual sessions.

perpetual.defaultPermission.description: Default permission mode for new turns.

perpetual.defaultExecutionBackend.description: Default execution backend. Docker Sandbox currently supports Codex only.

perpetual.defaultModel.description: Optional model override for new sessions. Empty uses the selected agent CLI default.

perpetual.defaultReasoning.description: Optional reasoning-effort override for new sessions.

perpetual.collaboration.deviceName.description: Friendly name shown to paired Perpetual devices. Empty uses this computer's hostname.

perpetual.defaultLocalProvider.description: Optional local model provider for new Codex sessions. Empty uses cloud/default agent behavior.

perpetual.defaultLocalBaseUrl.description: Optional base URL for the local model provider. Empty uses http://127.0.0.1:11434 for Ollama or http://127.0.0.1:1234 for LM Studio.

perpetual.autoSwitchOnLimit.description: When the current agent hits a usage limit, continue the task on the other ready agent.

perpetual.switchBackOnRecovery.description: After an automatic agent switch, return to the original agent once it recovers.

perpetual.fallbackPriority.description: Advanced: provider order used only when more than one fallback agent is available. With Claude/Codex, Perpetual skips the limited current agent and uses the other one.

perpetual.autoResumeOnLimitReset.description: Automatically resume paused limit-waiting tasks as soon as the relevant rate limit resets.

perpetual.resumeWithEarliestAgent.description: Legacy name for autoResumeOnLimitReset. Kept for existing installations.

perpetual.unknownLimitRetrySeconds.description: Retry interval when an agent reports a usage limit without a reset time. Set 0 to wait indefinitely.

perpetual.cloud.autoCarryover.description: Cloud Continuity: automatically carry active tasks over to the provider's cloud (Claude Code on the web / Codex Cloud) so they keep running when this machine can't.

perpetual.cloud.carryOverOnSleep.description: Carry running tasks over to the cloud when the machine is about to sleep. Requires auto carryover.

perpetual.cloud.carryOverOnShutdown.description: Carry running tasks over to the cloud on shutdown or when the daemon stops. Requires auto carryover.

enumDescriptions: Continue in the same provider's cloud (Claude Code sessions go to Claude Code on the web, Codex sessions to Codex Cloud).
Allow switching providers when the current one's cloud isn't ready (e.g. hand a Claude Code task to Codex Cloud).
perpetual.cloud.providerStrategy.description: Which provider's cloud receives a carried-over task.

perpetual.cloud.providerPriority.description: When cross-provider cloud handoff is enabled and the current provider is not ready, choose this cloud provider first.

perpetual.cloud.requireApproval.description: Ask for approval before work is handed to Codex Cloud or Claude Code on the web.

perpetual.cloud.maxConcurrentRuns.description: Maximum number of cloud runs carried over at the same time.

perpetual.cloud.codexEnvId.description: Codex Cloud environment id used for carried-over Codex tasks. Create one at chatgpt.com/codex.

perpetual.local.autoResumeCloud.description: Resume cloud agents automatically when network/cloud connectivity returns.

perpetual.local.useFallback.description: Use selected local models when cloud agents are unavailable.

perpetual.local.switchBackToCloud.description: Switch local fallback runs back to cloud agents after connectivity is stable.

perpetual.local.probeIntervalSeconds.description: How often to probe cloud/local recovery while waiting.

perpetual.local.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Ollama base URL for detection and local fallback. Empty uses http://127.0.0.1:11434.

perpetual.local.lmStudioBaseUrl.description: LM Studio base URL for detection and local fallback. Empty uses http://127.0.0.1:1234.

perpetual.sandbox.cpus.description: CPU limit for each Docker Sandbox run.

perpetual.sandbox.memory.description: Memory limit for each Docker Sandbox run.

perpetual.sandbox.networkPreset.description: Network policy preset for Docker Sandbox runs.

perpetual.daemonPath.description: Optional path to an am-daemon binary. Empty uses the binary bundled with this extension.

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run typecheck:webview && npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck:webview
